events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's big day
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis, turns 54 today. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51 years
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday.

angles.name: Sting's 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the man, the myth, the Sting! From The Police to his solo career, his music has truly spanned the decades. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: First iPod released (2001)
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: 25 years ago today, Apple dropped the original iPod and changed music forever. Who remembers painstakingly syncing their entire CD collection onto one of these?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your top 007 moment? Licence to thrill us with your answers!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the profound impact of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double album packed with diverse sounds and timeless tracks. What's your go-to from this masterpiece?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost an icon. Remembering the incredible talent and unforgettable stage presence of Freddie Mercury. His legacy lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' groundbreaking album that marked a creative turning point. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate deeply. We remember him today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary innovator, David Bowie.

angles.name: Remembering Bowie
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we're celebrating the unparalleled artistry and fearless reinvention of David Bowie. Which era of Bowie is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King lives on through his incredible music!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's iconic guitarist and songwriter, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Jimmy Page's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track with his iconic guitar work?
